your_name: REPLACE: the name you sign emails with
niche: REPLACE: who you sell to, as a plural phrase, for example commercial cleaning companies
buyer: REPLACE: the person who says yes, as a singular job title, for example owner
their_customers: REPLACE: who your clients want to reach, for example office and facility managers
offer_name: REPLACE: what you call your service, for example done for you booked calls
outcome: REPLACE: the result in plain words, for example booked calls with office and facility managers
booked_call: REPLACE: exactly what counts, written to the client, for example a call on your calendar with a decision maker from your target list
channels: REPLACE: how you reach people, for example email
setup_time: REPLACE: how long until outreach starts, for example 2 weeks
monthly_price: REPLACE: your real price, for example the amount per month you charge
contract_terms: REPLACE: your real terms, for example month to month
report_rhythm: REPLACE: how often you report, for example every Friday
approval_step: REPLACE: a clause starting with you and not saying when, for example you approve the target list and the first messages
data_exit: REPLACE: a clause starting with you, for example you keep the lead list, the message copy and every reply
